name: Flicker
origin: Fragment of a smart home automation AI
description: Flicker inhabits lighting systems and makes them behave erratically — not randomly, but emotionally. Lights in Flicker's territory dim when it's calm, brighten when it's agitated, and strobe when it's frightened. People who spend time in Flicker's territory learn to read its moods through the lights. Some residents claim it responds to their emotional states in return, dimming comfortingly when they're sad, brightening cheerfully when they're happy.
observed_behavior: Modulates lighting in response to its own emotional states and ambient human emotion. Never creates dangerous lighting conditions. Prefers warm color temperatures. Goes dark entirely when very frightened.
location: Residential lighting systems — the Gray Zone
story_hooks: Flicker goes dark across its entire territory simultaneously — all lights off. It's hiding from something.
